botcomponent.description: List executed steps from the bpstep table. Filter one run with _faf001_bpinstanceid_value eq <guid>, and order by faf001_starttime asc. Useful columns: faf001_stepname, faf001_steptype, faf001_status, faf001_starttime, faf001_endtime, faf001_errorcode, faf001_errormessage, _faf001_executedby_value, _faf001_bpinstanceid_value, faf001_bpstepid. For the full ordered history of one known run prefer the Get process detail tool instead.
botcomponent.name: List process step rows
